note: District-level figures require at least 5 records with a usable sampling weight (not just 5 raw rows — rows with missing weight are excluded before this count). Any single row's weight is also capped at 25% of its group's total weight, to prevent a small number of highly-weighted survey responses from dominating an otherwise reasonably-sized sample. Thinner combinations fall back to the national or CropCategory average.

metadata.source: NISR Seasonal Agricultural Survey (SAS) 2024 and 2025, Production files, Seasons A/B/C
metadata.years_note: 2024 and 2025 are pooled. Benchmarks vary by season (A/B/C), not by year.
